title: 8bitnews country sources profile
description: Schema for countries/<cc>/sources.yaml. The literal string "tbd" is a valid placeholder for any free-text string field until the value is filled in (see --strict mode of cmd/profiles). country and language are structural identifiers used for cross-checks against channel.yaml and are never "tbd"; they must match their regex from the start.

kind.description: Outlet type. Keep in sync with the actual values used in countries/*/sources.yaml.

leaning.description: Editorial leaning on the local political spectrum; matches newsroom/contracts/local_press_report.schema.json minus "unknown", which only agents may emit when they cannot determine it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; must correspond to the directory under countries/ (case-insensitive) and match the country of every channel.yaml referencing this file.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag; must match the language of every channel.yaml referencing this file.
